test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter/symbol will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'Q'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8d5c39bf591e4ee23d8e25927d67ec20b45a5d33c61dd703c6933c18a56074.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2419070234bbe6eb6099bfb279fc77a437ea046be16c2b19da4912d29f9f2894.png] 

A and @ is the opposite sides.

# and Q is the opposite sides.

P and R is the opposite sides.

So, the face of '#' is opposite to the face showing 'Q'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
